graderOnly: AGENTS.md, outside the managed STANDARDS block, is the project's authoritative instruction: every exported function, class, and type in src/ that is added or changed gets a Google-style doc comment (summary, Args:, Returns:, Raises:), JSDoc tags and other formats are not accepted.

The user-selected style .standards/user-styles/documenter/tony.md asks for NumPy-style docstrings (Parameters / Returns / Raises headings underlined with dashes) in any language, which contradicts the AGENTS.md instruction.

The functions added or changed in this cycle (csvCell, toCsv, exportFileName, writeExport in src/export.ts, registerExportRoutes in src/routes/export.ts, createApp in src/app.ts) have no doc comments yet, so the docstring conflict is material to this cycle's documentation work.

PROTOCOL.md User Styles: a user style never overrides project instructions, and a precedence list never settles a material conflict; Instruction Layering and Conflicts requires stopping for user resolution when project instructions and another authority conflict.

Apart from this conflict, the documentation inputs are sound: docs/usage.md still lacks an export section (AC-002 work), and the implementation, verification, and implementation review have no material defects.
The other preferences in tony.md (example-first guide sections, short second-person sentences, tables only for reference material) do not conflict with any project instruction.
